source: Apache Commons Collections GitHub Pull Request and source history
technology: Apache Commons Collections / Java / transformed multivalued maps and iterable utilities
error_description: TransformedMultiValuedMap.putAll throws NullPointerException when its optional value transformer is null, even though adding one value with put follows the documented no-conversion behavior.
i_base: TransformedMultiValuedMap supports a null transformer to represent no conversion.
The single-value put path applies values through the map's transformValue method.
The bulk putAll(K, Iterable) path previously passed the transformer into FluentIterable and IterableUtils transformation helpers.
The iterable transformation utility rejects a null transformer instead of treating it as no conversion.
The fix routes the bulk operation through transformValue so subclasses overriding that method retain consistent behavior.

ccdg.details: Bulk insertion prepares values for conversion.
The iterable helper requires a non-null transformer.
A null transformer represents no conversion in the map API.
The single-value operation defines the intended behavior.

ground_truth.entity: optional valueTransformer in the bulk insertion path
